model: AXIOM DV-APS/TC, Twin APS/TC and AXIOM-APS (half-gallon brewers)
notes: Half-gallon commercial BUNN AXIOM brewers. The one service manual covers the DV, APS, DV-APS/TC and Twin variants, and the Twin schematics show two of each brew-system part (control board, tank heater, probes, valves), so counts depend on the variant. The 1425 W tank heater, 100 W warmer and 50 W blanket are the 120 V versions; the manual lists other heaters for 200 to 240 V, so check the voltage plate before reusing one.

gaps: One manual covers AXIOM, DV, Twin 0/6, 2/2 and 4/2, APS, DV-APS/TC, Twin APS/TC, TS and AXIOM-15 schematics; most component pages do not say which variant they apply to, so specs name a variant only where the manual does.
The tank-heater chart sits under the manual's DV tank-heater figure; it does not say which other models use which heater. The 2268 W heater is listed only at 240 V.
The triac chips are too small to read on the rendered control-board page, so no chip markings and no datasheet are given.
The 0.08 to 0.20 A brew-valve figure is an amp-clamp test reading, not a rating, so no amps are set on the part.
The text layer drops the ohm sign after the tank probe readings (10.5K and 870); the rendered page 23 shows it.
The relay, limit thermostat and thermal cut-off have no ratings in the manual; warmer, TCO and brew-system quantities are not stated, so none is set.
The voltage selector's location line (mounting bracket behind the front panel) and its removal step (left side of the trunk) disagree, so no location is given.
method: BUNN's own copy of the AXIOM Series Service & Repair Manual 39132.0000 (revision J, 05/25, catalog.bunn.com), read as text with research.js pdf; pages 12, 20, 23 and 24 rendered and read, and the schematic pages 42, 45 and 46 of the revision G copy rendered.
The cdn.shopify.com copy (revision G, 03/14, BUNN-O-MATIC cover) was read first; pages 4 to 33 match the bunn.com copy word for word, and only some schematic pages differ in wire colours and dates.
The tank-heater, warmer and blanket charts are in ohms (rendered page 20 and 24).
No parts catalogue or other BUNN manual was used.

comps.spec: Five triacs per control board, TH1 to TH5, driving the warmer outputs, brew solenoid, refill solenoid and main warmer; TH2 and TH4 are paired with MOV-1 and MOV-2 in the manual's triac map.
Relay on the control board; the manual has you disconnect its wires before the board comes out.
Tank heater of the AXIOM DV (the manual's DV tank-heater figure): 1425 W at 120 V, the small-diameter element, 10.10 ohm in the resistance chart. The same chart lists other heaters for 200 to 240 V.
Warmer element under the warmer plate, 100 W at 120 V, 144 ohm in the manual's chart (220 V and 200 V versions are also listed).
Blanket warmer wrapped around the tank, 50 W at 120 V, 288 ohm in the manual's chart (a 220 V version is also listed).
Limit thermostat held in a retaining clip against the front side of the tank; the manual checks it for continuity across its terminals.
comps.loc: Inside the top cover on the front side of the tank

comps.spec: Thermal cut-off (TCO) under the tank at the heater connections; its manual section is headed for 230-volt models only, and it is checked for continuity.
comps.loc: Under the tank at the heater connections

comps.spec: Brew valve (the troubleshooting table calls it the dispense valve), a solenoid with an internally rectified coil that reads 120 VAC across its terminals in the manual test, so no ohm test. Amp-clamp test value on one wire: 0.08 to 0.20 A when on (a test figure, not a rating).
comps.loc: Inside the top cover behind the front face plate

comps.spec: Refill valve (solenoid) with early-model and later-model versions; in the manual's test its coil reads 120 V ac on two-wire 120 V and three-wire 120/208-240 V models.
comps.loc: Inside the front of the brewer

comps.spec: Tank temperature probe inserted through the tank lid and pulled out of a grommet; its two-pin connector plugs into J9 on the control board. The manual's resistance check across its terminals reads about 10.5 kilohms cool to about 870 ohms at ready temperature (units from the rendered page 23).
Two water level probes per tank, one long and one short, in grommets in the tank lid, wired to a 3-pin level probe harness on the control board.
Master ON/OFF rocker or toggle switch. Earlier models have it on the left side of the trunk; later models have a toggle on the back of the trunk.
comps.loc: Left side of trunk (earlier) or back of trunk (later)

comps.spec: Voltage selector switch with a 120 V position and a 120/208-240 V position; it appears in the AXIOM DV and DV-APS/TC schematics.

Brew tank with a bolted lid: the tank heaters are secured to its bottom, the temperature probe and level probes go through the lid, and the blanket warmer wraps around it. The manual removes it as a tank assembly once four mounting nuts are off.
Hoses on the brew valve, held in place with clamps

sources.title: BUNN AXIOM Series Service & Repair Manual, 39132.0000J (05/25), BUNN catalog copy (catalog.bunn.com)
